name: WittyPhotos
summary: Photo libraries: what a photo says about itself (RAW files too), albums, the map, and the photo screens on every app.
updates: All of it: reading EXIF, picture sizes and RAW previews; albums; the photo map's settings; and its screens, in the web app and on every app (timeline, albums, map).
stays: Scanning photo libraries and keeping what EXIF says, the pictures themselves, uploads and share links stay the server's.
